item.text: I’m applying the `okhp3-linkedin-series-continuity` skill to check what the calendar entry supports and identify the minimum needed for a draft.

- There’s no supported new point to draft yet. Once you supply one, the draft can stand on its own without implying the scheduled post appeared.
